name: flow-resistance-transition
source:
// The 2300-4000 transition band of the Darcy friction factor
{ The band is a linear blend between the laminar 64/Re at the local Re and
  Colebrook evaluated at Re = 4000. Because the laminar term keeps falling
  while the blend weight rises, f dips below its Re = 2300 value before
  climbing to the turbulent value - it is continuous but NOT monotone. }
epsD = 0.0009

f2300 = friction_factor(2300, epsD)
f2400 = friction_factor(2400, epsD)
f2600 = friction_factor(2600, epsD)
f2800 = friction_factor(2800, epsD)
f3000 = friction_factor(3000, epsD)
f3500 = friction_factor(3500, epsD)
f3900 = friction_factor(3900, epsD)
f3999 = friction_factor(3999.999, epsD)
f4000 = friction_factor(4000, epsD)
f4001 = friction_factor(4000.001, epsD)

f2300_smooth = friction_factor(2300, 0)
f3000_smooth = friction_factor(3000, 0)
f4000_smooth = friction_factor(4000, 0)
f2000_rough = friction_factor(2000, 0.05)
f3000_rough = friction_factor(3000, 0.05)
